subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – thank-you page, domain and invoices
body_text:
Hi Anita,

Thank you for your time. You came with a list of things to sort out, from your thank-you page and mobile buttons to spam emails, invoices, lesson unlocking and your student list.

What we completed during the call:
- You pasted your thank-you page link into the redirect field under After purchase settings and saved it. A test order now goes to your thank-you page.
- You increased the spacing between the two buttons in the mobile view, and confirmed on your phone that they are now separate.

What we discussed:
- Emails going to spam: in Email settings, add your domain, then add the three DNS records at your registrar and click Verify. This is not fully resolved until that is done.
- EARLYBIRD coupon: you can change its expiry date in the coupon settings if you decide to extend it. That is your call.
- Lesson unlocking: there is a drip schedule setting for lessons, but we are not yet sure it works for a course sold inside a bundle, so this is not resolved yet.
- AI quiz generator: we are not aware of one being available and have no date for it, so please do not plan around it.
- Student list: go to Students, click Export and choose CSV.

What you need to do next:
1. Have your developer add the three DNS records by Friday, as you mentioned, then click Verify in your email settings.
2. Try exporting your student list.

What we'll do next:
- We will check with our billing team about changing the GST name on your invoices to your company name, and get back to you within 2 working days. This is not resolved yet.
- We will check with our product team whether the drip schedule works for a course sold inside a bundle, and get back to you.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-10

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
